name: Quick eSelling
description_en:
Quick eSelling is a managed ecommerce website and mobile-app service. Its homepage advertises a free website and Android app, including hosted operation and no platform transaction fee, while asking merchants to connect their own domain and payment gateway.

The B2B offering adds business registration, customer-group pricing, quantity rules and reorder workflows. Free service advertising should be separated from payment-provider costs, domains, custom work and the actual terms of account use.
description_zh:
Quick eSelling 是托管电商网站及移动应用服务。主页宣传免费网站和 Android 应用，包含托管且不收平台交易费，同时要求商家配置自有域名和支付网关。

B2B 方案增加企业注册、客户组价格、数量规则及复购流程。免费服务宣传应与支付服务商费用、域名、定制工作和实际账户条款分开。

core_features.name_zh: 托管网站及 Android 应用
core_features.explanation_en: The homepage advertises a hosted website and Android app without platform hosting/bandwidth/transaction charges.
core_features.explanation_zh: 主页宣传托管网站及 Android 应用，不收平台托管、带宽和交易费。

core_features.explanation_en: Configure minimum/multiple order quantities, units and customer-group pricing.
core_features.explanation_zh: 配置最小及整倍订购量、单位和客户组价格。

core_features.explanation_en: The B2B page includes order history, returns and quick reorder.
core_features.explanation_zh: B2B 页包含订单历史、退货及快速复购。

official_check.scope: Public official pages read and bilingual draft cross-checked; no account, purchase, execution, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent validation.
Examples and suitability judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese copy does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.en: A wholesaler could create a business customer group, define a minimum and order multiple, then allow reordering from history. The B2B page documents group prices, units of measure and quantity restrictions. Test an invalid quantity, a customer in the wrong group and a returned order. Define whether a reordered item uses today’s price or the historical value; the public page does not settle that rule.
sections.zh: 批发商可建立企业客户组，设置最小及整倍订购量，再允许从历史订单复购。B2B 页列有组价格、计量单位及数量限制。应测试无效数量、错误客户组和退货订单，并确认复购采用当前价还是历史价；公开页未说明该规则。

sections.title_en: Identify exactly what the free claim covers
sections.title_zh: 明确免费宣传覆盖范围
sections.en: The homepage says no hosting, bandwidth or platform transaction charges and advertises website plus Android app. It also asks users to configure their domain and payment gateway, and mentions possible expert theme customization. No comprehensive numeric price list for custom development, app-store delivery, add-ons or gateway processing was verified. Do not equate the headline with an unlimited enterprise contract or zero total operating cost.
sections.zh: 主页说明不收托管、带宽及平台交易费，并宣传网站加 Android 应用，同时要求配置域名及支付网关，还提及专业主题定制。未核实定制开发、应用商店交付、附加项或支付处理的完整数字价目，不能把标题当作无限企业合同或零总运营成本。

sections.title_en: Hosted use is licensed, not ownership of the software
sections.title_zh: 托管使用是许可，并非拥有软件
sections.en: The terms describe software and service intellectual property as belonging to Quick eSelling or its providers and being licensed rather than sold. They also permit deletion of archived customer data within 30 days after termination. Confirm an export and business continuity plan before loading irreplaceable records; this is a product-contract observation, not legal advice or approval of the terms. No self-hosted distribution was verified.
sections.zh: 条款说明软件及服务知识产权属于 Quick eSelling 或提供方，以许可而非出售方式使用，并允许在终止后 30 天内删除归档客户数据。导入不可替代记录前应确认导出及业务持续方案；这是产品合同说明，不是法律建议或对条款的批准。未核实自托管发行版。

sections.title_en: Start with products, payments and delivery rules
sections.title_zh: 从商品、支付及配送规则开始
sections.en: The service is relevant to merchants seeking hosted website/app commerce with B2B options. A team needing backend source ownership should resolve the licensing difference first. Prepare catalogue, stock, customer groups, gateway credentials and shipping zones. Trial-free marketing does not verify a working checkout; no live app, order, refund, ERP integration or recovery procedure was tested.
sections.zh: 需要托管网站应用电商并有 B2B 选项的商家可评估该服务。需要后端源码所有权的团队应先核对许可差异。应准备目录、库存、客户组、支付凭据和配送区。免费宣传不能证明结账已可用，本文未测试真实应用、订单、退款、ERP 集成或恢复。
